verdict.rationale: Goodwin's VC practice explicitly serves international fund formation ('domestic and international funds ranging from less than $25 million to over $10 billion') and the firm has 18 offices spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, indicating real cross-border capability. However, the self-serve Founders Workbench tools (Document Driver, Capital Calculator) are explicitly limited to Delaware corp/LLC formation with no mention of flips, redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financing document support. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of flip/redomiciliation services, cross-border investor-specific deal terms, or multi-jurisdiction financing document templates.
